# Index types — concept pack

> The kinds of index the sources describe and what each is for: B-tree, hash, GIN, GiST/SP-GiST, BRIN, bloom, compound/composite, unique, partial/filtered, multikey, wildcard, text/full-text and search, geospatial (2d/2dsphere), TTL, hidden, expression and clustered indexes, and vector indexes (HNSW, IVFFlat, DiskANN). Child pack of Indexing.
